description: tiles.immich.cloud: the Cloudflare worker that serves Immich's map tiles, TileJSON and styles, and the Bunny storage zone and pull zone replacing it. Worker metrics are per-minute sums from o11y's serverless ingest path, added up with sum_over_time; the Bunny sections show the daily sync's runs (one point per run), the CDN request logs' per-minute counts and the synthetic probe. Logs are the worker's errors and a 1% request sample, and the sync's and its watchdog's lines.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: Requests the worker answered in the last 15 minutes, per second, CDN hits included.

panels.title: 5xx responses
panels.description: Share of responses in the last 15 minutes that were 5xx. The Tiles 5xx alert fires above 2%.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile of the worker's time per request in the last 15 minutes, CDN hits included. The Tiles slow alert fires above 1.5 s.

panels.title: Tile CDN hits
panels.description: Share of tile requests in the last hour answered from the CDN cache without reading storage.

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time(tiles_cdn_hit_count:1m_sum_samples{project="geoshenanigans", cluster="tiles", request_type="tile"}[1h])) or vector(0)) / sum(sum_over_time({__name__=~"tiles_cdn_hit_count:1m_sum_samples|tiles_tile_request_invocation:1m_sum_samples", project="geoshenanigans", cluster="tiles", z!=""}[1h]))

panels.title: Requests, 24h
panels.description: Requests the worker answered in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Deployment served
panels.description: The deployment key (the build date of the tiles) CDN hits carried in the last 15 minutes. Two keys mean a deploy is rolling out.

panels.title: Requests/s by type
panels.description: Every response by request type (tile, json for the TileJSON, style, unknown for anything else).

panels.title: Responses/s by status
panels.description: Every response by HTTP status. 304s answer clients that already have the live deployment's TileJSON, style or unversioned tile.

panels.title: 5xx responses/s by type
panels.description: Failed responses by request type. The log panel below has each failure's error and Cf-Ray.

panels.title: Requests/s by continent
panels.description: Where requests reached Cloudflare.

panels.title: Request latency
panels.description: The worker's time per request, CDN hits included, from the per-minute histograms.

panels.title: Uncached tile p95 by continent
panels.description: Tiles the CDN didn't have: a D1 directory lookup and a Tigris read, by where the request reached Cloudflare.

panels.title: Tile CDN hits by zoom
panels.description: Share of each zoom level's tile requests answered from the CDN cache.

targets.expr: (sum by (z) (sum_over_time(tiles_cdn_hit_count:1m_sum_samples{project="geoshenanigans", cluster="tiles", request_type="tile"}[$__interval])) or on (z) (0 * sum by (z) (sum_over_time({__name__=~"tiles_cdn_hit_count:1m_sum_samples|tiles_tile_request_invocation:1m_sum_samples", project="geoshenanigans", cluster="tiles", z!=""}[$__interval])))) / sum by (z) (sum_over_time({__name__=~"tiles_cdn_hit_count:1m_sum_samples|tiles_tile_request_invocation:1m_sum_samples", project="geoshenanigans", cluster="tiles", z!=""}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Tile requests/s by zoom
panels.description: Tile requests by zoom level, CDN hits and misses together.

panels.title: D1 query p95 by region
panels.description: Directory lookups by the D1 replica region that answered.

panels.title: D1 queries on the primary
panels.description: Share of D1 queries the primary answered instead of a nearby replica: replicas spin down when idle, which the per-request warm-up query is there to prevent.

panels.title: Tigris read latency
panels.description: Reads from the tiles-geo bucket (tile ranges, styles), by endpoint.

panels.title: Busiest colos
panels.description: The 25 Cloudflare colos with the most requests in the dashboard's time range, with their p95 time per request.

panels.title: Busiest sites (sampled)
panels.description: The sites (Origin's registrable domain) and networks behind the most requests in the sampled request logs: 1 request in 100 is logged, so multiply by 100. Metrics leave these out, as a series per site would never end. Requests without an Origin, such as the Immich apps', have no site.

targets.expr: project:="geoshenanigans" cluster:="tiles" kind:="request" | stats by (apex_domain, as_org) count() sampled_requests | sort by (sampled_requests desc) | limit 25

panels.title: Last sync
panels.description: The status of the latest Tiles Sync run in the past 26h (tiles-sync.yml, twice a day). skipped: the newest Protomaps build was live already, or the schedule is held (TILES_SYNC_HOLD). guard_rail: more positions changed than the guard rail allows; schema_changed: the build's schema version differs from the live one's. Both upload nothing. no_state: the state zone has no state.json (before the first load).

panels.title: Live build age
panels.description: Hours since the live build's date, as the watchdog last read state.json (every 2h).

panels.title: Live OSM data age
panels.description: Age of the OSM data in the live build, as the watchdog last read it. The tiles-osm-old alert fires above 48h.

panels.title: Changed positions
panels.description: Tile positions whose tile changed in the latest sync that diffed. The diff-large alert fires above 1M; a day is usually 200-330k.

panels.title: Last sync duration
panels.description: Time from first step to last, download included, of the most recent sync job that reported a duration in the past 26h. A run the resolver stops before the sync job (the build already live, syncs held, a schema change) reports no duration and leaves the previous job's shown. The sync-slow alert fires above 2h.

panels.title: Replication
panels.description: Result of the most recent replication gate reported in the past 26h; runs that end before the gate report none and leave it shown. Complete means every file the run changed was stored with the right checksum and reached the regions that run waited for: every replica region by default, only those in the regions input or TILES_SYNC_REGIONS when set, or none (primary storage only) with regions set to none.

panels.title: Sync runs by status
panels.description: One point per run of tiles-sync.yml, by status, over the last 14 days.

panels.title: Sync step durations
panels.description: Seconds per step of each sync: download (the workflow's), manifest, diff, upload, replication, static, purge and state (the sync CLI's), and the total. The dashed line is the sync-slow alert's 2h.

panels.title: Replication wait by region
panels.description: Seconds the sync's replication gates waited until each checked storage region held every file they checked: the tile gate's wait from its start plus the TileJSON and styles gate's, added up. A region with no point was not selected for that run (the regions input or TILES_SYNC_REGIONS) or did not catch up before one of the gates ended.

panels.title: Changed positions
panels.description: Positions whose tile changed against the live build, and the files the sync uploaded for them. The dashed line is the diff-large alert's 1M.

panels.title: Bytes uploaded
panels.description: Tile bytes the sync uploaded to the storage zone (before replication).

panels.title: Retries and rate limits
panels.description: PUTs the uploader retried, and the 429s among them, per sync.

panels.title: Live build and OSM data age
panels.description: The live build's age and its OSM data's, from the watchdog every 2h. The dashed line is the tiles-osm-old alert's 48h.

panels.title: Sync and watchdog logs
panels.description: A line per sync run (status, build, changed positions, uploads, replication, step seconds and the run's URL) and its error, a line per watchdog tick, and a line per daily sample check (app tiles-sample-check: counts and example paths). Every sync line carries app, level and the sync's run_id, build and status.

targets.expr: project:="geoshenanigans" cluster:="tiles" app:in("tiles-sync", "tiles-sync-watchdog", "tiles-sample-check") | sort by (_time desc)

panels.title: Sample check: not yet in a region
panels.description: Of the daily sample of live positions (up to 100 per zoom), the files stored with the right bytes that each storage region does not hold yet; that region serves them from Frankfurt. After a seed this is the replication backlog draining, but zero only means no sampled file lacked the region: confirm the backlog has drained with the full zoom-15 listing in the go-live checklist (deployment/modules/bunny/tiles/README.md) before clearing TILES_SYNC_REGIONS or cutting over.

panels.title: Sample check: missing or other bytes
panels.description: Of the daily sample of live positions, those with no file (a 404 for users) or with other bytes than the live manifest. Both should be zero; the sample check's log line names examples.

panels.title: Bunny requests/s by status
panels.description: Every request in the pull zone's logs (the log reader's per-minute counts) by HTTP status.

panels.title: Bunny requests/s by cache status
panels.description: Every request by the CDN's cache status (HIT, MISS...).

panels.title: Bunny requests/s by type
panels.description: tile, tilejson, style or other.

panels.title: Bunny requests/s by edge location
panels.description: Every request by the Bunny edge location (the log's edgeLocation, e.g. DE or UK) that served it.

panels.title: Bunny bytes/s by edge location
panels.description: Bytes sent to clients, by edge location.

panels.title: Busiest countries (Bunny)
panels.description: The 25 client countries with the most requests in the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Bunny tile requests/s by zoom
panels.description: Tile requests by zoom level.

panels.title: Bunny tile cache hits by zoom
panels.description: Share of each zoom level's tile requests the CDN answered from its cache: 0 when a zoom had requests but no hits (a cold cache after a purge), a gap when it had no requests.

targets.expr: (sum by (zoom) (sum_over_time(tiles_bunny_tile_requests{project="geoshenanigans", cluster="tiles", cache=~"(?i)hit"}[$__interval])) or on (zoom) (0 * sum by (zoom) (sum_over_time(tiles_bunny_tile_requests{project="geoshenanigans", cluster="tiles"}[$__interval])))) / sum by (zoom) (sum_over_time(tiles_bunny_tile_requests{project="geoshenanigans", cluster="tiles"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Log reader
panels.description: Log rows per plotted interval, log-reader runs by result, and the lag: the age in seconds of the newest row the Logging API returned from the past 10 minutes, when the reader ran. On a quiet zone that is the age of the last request, not a delay; with no row in 10 minutes there is no lag point. The bunny-logs-silent alert fires when no minute has been processed (no tiles_bunny_log_rows sample) for 15 minutes while the Worker heartbeat arrives and the reader has reported in the past week, after a 5-minute pending period.

panels.title: Probe first byte, misses
panels.description: The synthetic probe's time to first byte for tests the edge answered as a cache miss (a CDN-Cache other than HIT or STALE), by the continent of the Globalping probe: normally the random z15 tile, and the popular tile too after a purge or at a cold edge. A test without a CDN-Cache header counts as the tile it tested. The dashed line is the bunny-probe-slow alert's 1s.

targets.expr: sum by (continent) (sum_over_time(tiles_bunny_probe_ttfb_ms{project="geoshenanigans", cluster="tiles", kind="miss"}[$__interval])) / sum by (continent) (count_over_time(tiles_bunny_probe_ttfb_ms{project="geoshenanigans", cluster="tiles", kind="miss"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Probe first byte, hits
panels.description: The synthetic probe's time to first byte for tests the edge answered from its cache (CDN-Cache HIT or STALE), by the continent of the Globalping probe: normally the popular tile, and the random tile when that edge already held it. A test without a CDN-Cache header counts as the tile it tested.

targets.expr: sum by (continent) (sum_over_time(tiles_bunny_probe_ttfb_ms{project="geoshenanigans", cluster="tiles", kind="hit"}[$__interval])) / sum by (continent) (count_over_time(tiles_bunny_probe_ttfb_ms{project="geoshenanigans", cluster="tiles", kind="hit"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Probe errors
panels.description: Failed probe tests by continent and observed cache kind (the cache status the edge reported, as in the first-byte panels). "worker tilejson" is the Worker's own read of the TileJSON (v1.json), which gives the probe its tile URLs: it failed or named no usable tile URL. Plus runs with a measurement error: the TileJSON unreadable or without a usable tile URL (no tile measured that run), a Globalping measurement refused or unfinished at the deadline, none of a target's tests with a verdict (the other target can still have verdicts), or a continent without a verdict (named in the missing field of the probe's error line; the other continents' tests still count). The bunny-probe-errors alert requires a majority of verdicts in 30 minutes to be failures in a continent and kind, with the same target failing in at least two runs. The bunny-probe-failing alert requires at least two runs with a measurement error and a majority of runs to have one in 30 minutes.

panels.title: Probe tests
panels.description: Every synthetic probe test (logged at info, so not under Errors and warnings): continent, kind (hit or miss), the URL, the status, the PoP that answered (Server header), first byte and the verdict. Measurement errors are under Errors and warnings.

targets.expr: project:="geoshenanigans" cluster:="tiles" kind:="probe" | sort by (_time desc)

panels.title: Errors and warnings
panels.description: The worker's error and warning lines. Each carries the request's ray (Cf-Ray), path, colo and continent; failures also their error and stack.

targets.expr: project:="geoshenanigans" cluster:="tiles" level:in("error", "warn") | sort by (_time desc)
